deep_research:9196874.true_research_question: In adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes, what is the effect of once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide 2.4 mg for 68 weeks, compared with pooled matched placebo, on percentage change from baseline in body weight at week 68?
deep_research:9196874.paper_type: Original investigation; phase 3b randomized clinical trial
deep_research:9196874.study_design: 68-week, randomized, open-label, parallel-group, multicenter phase 3b trial with active treatments double-blinded against matched placebo groups; treatment-policy estimand used ANCOVA with multiple imputation
main_groups: Once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide 2.4 mg plus diet and physical activity counseling (n=126 randomized)
Once-daily subcutaneous liraglutide 3.0 mg plus diet and physical activity counseling (n=127 randomized)
Pooled matched placebo plus diet and physical activity counseling (n=85 randomized)
